shadcn-ui.description: A collection of accessible components built on Radix UI and Tailwind, with copy-and-paste code straight into your project.
shadcn-ui.highlight: You don't install a package: the component code is copied into your app and becomes yours.

radix-ui.description: Headless, unstyled components for building accessible design systems, focused on behaviour and accessibility.
radix-ui.highlight: The infrastructure behind a good share of the most popular kits in the React ecosystem.

react-aria-components.description: A collection of headless components that implements interactions, focus and accessibility following the ARIA patterns.
react-aria-components.highlight: Complex behaviours (combobox, listbox, tables) ready and tested with keyboard navigation.

headless-ui.description: Accessible, unstyled components maintained by the Tailwind CSS team.
headless-ui.highlight: Ideal when you want 100% visual control without reimplementing focus, keyboard and ARIA.

ark-ui.description: Multi-framework headless UI primitives (React, Vue, Solid, Svelte) with the same API and accessibility through Zag.js.
ark-ui.highlight: A single headless design system that serves React, Vue, Solid and Svelte at once.

mantine.description: A complete React component framework with more than 120 components, hooks and ready-made utils.
mantine.highlight: Quite complete: notifications, modals, forms with validation, dates and utility hooks.

ant-design.description: Alibaba's enterprise design system, with more than 70 components aimed at complex products.
ant-design.highlight: A reference for tables, forms and complex back-office flows.

mui.description: React implementation of the Material Design components, with the largest examples ecosystem on the web.
mui.highlight: Thousands of examples, templates and ready-made integrations in the ecosystem.

chakra-ui.description: A component library focused on productivity, with a simple props API and a props-based style system.
chakra-ui.highlight: Great for quickly putting together your own design system, with token-based themes.

heroui.description: A production-ready React component library with light and dark themes, accessibility and direct Tailwind CSS integration.
heroui.highlight: Born as NextUI and renamed to HeroUI in 2024 — today one of the largest React component communities, with more than 30,000 stars.

semantic-ui-react.description: The React port of the popular Semantic UI framework, with strong semantics and coherent naming.
semantic-ui-react.highlight: A meaning-driven API: just like semantic HTML.

base-ui.description: A headless library of unstyled components, from the same family as MUI, focused on accessibility and composition.
base-ui.highlight: A natural successor to MUI Base: portals, focus traps and ARIA already solved.

tanstack-form.description: A headless form manager with strong typing, schema validation and adapters for any UI.
tanstack-form.highlight: End-to-end typing: the form errors are inferred from the validation schema.

react-hook-form.description: A performant form library built on hooks, with validation and minimised re-renders.
react-hook-form.highlight: The market standard for complex forms in React.

formik.description: A form manager for React with render props and easy integration with validation schemas.
formik.highlight: Very stable and battle-tested, even though it predates the more modern alternatives.

tanstack-table.description: A headless table library with sorting, filtering, pagination, grouping and virtualisation.
tanstack-table.highlight: Works for plain HTML as well as for React/Vue/Svelte/Angular with the same logic.

ag-grid.description: A high-performance data grid for large grids, with grouping, filtering and charts.
ag-grid.highlight: The Community edition is free and already handles millions of rows with virtualisation.

recharts.description: React chart components built on SVG, with a simple declarative API.
recharts.highlight: Easy to use for line, bar, area and pie charts.

visx.description: A low-level charting kit for React, with SVG primitives and d3 scales.
visx.highlight: For those who want total control over data visualisation.

lucide-react.description: An open source icon library with more than 1,500 consistent SVG icons.
lucide-react.highlight: Derived from Feather Icons, with a uniform stroke and per-icon installs to keep the bundle small.

phosphor-icons.description: A flexible icon family with variable weights and filled/outline/duotone variants.
phosphor-icons.highlight: An icon set that changes weight without losing its consistent stroke.

heroicons.description: Icons made by the Tailwind CSS team, in outline and solid, great for interfaces.
heroicons.highlight: A design consistent with Tailwind's visual language.

iconify.description: Unifies more than 200 icon sets in a single component, with search and a consistent API.
iconify.highlight: Lets you swap the icon package without rewriting the application code.

framer-motion.description: An animation library for React with gestures, layout animations, scroll-linked effects and more.
framer-motion.highlight: Declarative animations with physical springs and support for native gestures.

gsap.description: A high-performance web animation engine with timelines, ScrollTrigger and plugins.
gsap.highlight: The industry standard for complex animations and high-performance micro-interactions.

auto-animate.description: Adds transition animations to any component with a single line of code.
auto-animate.highlight: Zero configuration: it detects DOM changes and animates on its own.

dotlottie-web.description: The official LottieFiles player for Lottie (.json) and dotLottie (.lottie) animations, with a Rust + WASM core and Canvas, WebGL2 and WebGPU rendering.
dotlottie-web.highlight: One player for every stack — React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components — with themes, state machines and audio from the dotLottie v2 format.

tailwindcss.description: A utility CSS framework for building responsive designs without leaving your HTML.
tailwindcss.highlight: The styling base of most of today's component kits.

unocss.description: An extremely fast utility CSS engine with presets and a configurable theme.
unocss.highlight: Much faster than Tailwind, with total freedom over the rules.

panda-css.description: Utility CSS with design tokens and variants, focused on DX and on-demand generation.
panda-css.highlight: Design tokens as code, ideal for multi-platform design systems.

styled-components.description: CSS-in-JS with tagged template literals, theming and dynamic props.
styled-components.highlight: The most popular CSS-in-JS library, widely adopted in the React ecosystem.

emotion.description: A CSS-in-JS styling library focused on performance, with an API similar to styled-components.
emotion.highlight: A styling engine with fast insertion and support for Server Components.

vue.description: A progressive framework for building interfaces, with templates and native reactivity.
vue.highlight: The base of Nuxt, Vuetify, Naive UI and much of the Vue ecosystem.

vuetify.description: A Vue component framework following Material Design, with themes and responsive layout.
vuetify.highlight: The most adopted Vue component kit in large projects.

naive-ui.description: A component library for Vue 3 focused on token-based theming and tree-shaking.
naive-ui.highlight: A very granular CSS-in-JS theming system, with no configuration boilerplate.

element-plus.description: A Vue 3 component library widely used in admin panels.
element-plus.highlight: Strong on tables, forms and admin CRUD.

primevue.description: A Vue component suite with themes, primitives and an unstyled mode.
primevue.highlight: The unstyled mode lets you apply PrimeFlex tokens to any design system.

svelte.description: A compiler that turns components into lean JavaScript, with no client runtime.
svelte.highlight: Each component compiles to a single file — a tiny bundle by default.

shadcn-svelte.description: A port of the shadcn/ui philosophy to Svelte, with accessible components and copyable code.
shadcn-svelte.highlight: The same copy-and-paste experience, but with snippets for SvelteKit.

skeleton.description: A component kit for SvelteKit and Tailwind, with themes and accessible components.
skeleton.highlight: Built for SvelteKit: it works with loaders and action forms.

angular-material.description: The UI component library from the official Angular team, following Material Design.
angular-material.highlight: It follows the Angular release cycle and uses Signals.

ngx-bootstrap.description: Bootstrap 5 components ported to Angular, with datepicker, tooltip, modal, timepicker and more.
ngx-bootstrap.highlight: Full Bootstrap inside Angular, without Bootstrap's JavaScript — components only.

kobalte.description: A headless library of accessible components for SolidJS, created by the Hope UI team.
kobalte.highlight: Unstyled components focused on accessibility and composition.

hope-ui.description: A complete design system for SolidJS with more than 60 styled components.
hope-ui.highlight: One of the few UI libraries already ready for the Solid ecosystem.

qwik-ui.description: Headless and styled components for Qwik, focused on resilience and streaming.
qwik-ui.highlight: Designed to work well with Qwik's resumability.

material-web.description: Web components from the Material team, written in TypeScript with no framework.
material-web.highlight: Three flavours: React, Vue and plain Web Components.

webawesome.description: Ready-to-use Web Components with themes, icons and animations, with no framework dependencies.
webawesome.highlight: The successor to Shoelace: import the component and use the HTML tag — it works in any stack.

lit.description: A minimal library for building Web Components with templates, reactive properties and styles.
lit.highlight: Tiny (~5kb), interoperable and used as the base by several frameworks.

ionic.description: A component kit for hybrid and web apps, focused on mobile-first and native platforms.
ionic.highlight: One codebase for iOS, Android and the web (Capacitor).

hyperui.description: A free collection of ready-to-copy HTML/Tailwind components.
hyperui.highlight: No dependencies, no heavy CSS classes — just HTML and Tailwind.

uiverse.description: A library of components, buttons and CSS animations ready to use in any project.
uiverse.highlight: Thousands of visual snippets you paste into your HTML.

daisyui.description: A Tailwind CSS plugin with more than 50 components and multiple ready-made themes.
daisyui.highlight: Swap themes with a single class, and still build your own themes with CSS.

flowbite.description: Components, templates and code blocks for Tailwind, with an official plugin.
flowbite.highlight: A large library of ready-made blocks: dashboards, e-commerce, charts and pages.

bulma.description: A Flexbox-based CSS framework with ready-made components and customisation through Sass variables.
bulma.highlight: CSS only: no JavaScript and no framework dependency, so Bulma serves any stack.

open-props.description: Modernised CSS custom properties with variants, defaults and quick adjustments for your design system.
open-props.highlight: CSS variables with a defaults system that adjusts itself by context.

tamagui.description: A universal UI kit for React Native and the web, with compiled styles, tokens and optimised components.
tamagui.highlight: One codebase for iOS, Android and the web with native-like styling performance.

nativebase.description: A component library for React Native and the web, with themes and an accessible design system.
nativebase.highlight: Universal components that behave the same on React Native, the web and Expo.

react-native-paper.description: A Material Design implementation for React Native with more than 30 accessible components.
react-native-paper.highlight: Material You (Dynamic Color) and native RTL support.

tabler-icons.description: More than 5,500 open source icons in a fillable outline style, consistent on a 24x24 grid.
tabler-icons.highlight: Variable weights (outline/filled) and packages for React, Vue, Svelte, HTML and Figma.

remix-icon.description: An open source line-style icon set with more than 2,700 neutral, readable symbols.
remix-icon.highlight: A neutral design that works in any interface, with official packages for multiple frameworks.

bootstrap-icons.description: The official Bootstrap icon library with more than 1,800 optimised SVG icons.
bootstrap-icons.highlight: Designed to work with or without Bootstrap, in any web project.

iconoir.description: More than 1,300 free open source icons, with no dependencies and a consistent style.
iconoir.highlight: 100% free, no pro version, with packages for React, Vue, Flutter, HTML and Figma.

eva-icons.description: Akveo's icon package with more than 600 icons, outline and fill styles, animations included.
eva-icons.highlight: Animated icons via Lottie/Web, with native support for React Native and the web.

material-icons.description: The official Google Material Design icons, with 2,100+ symbols in 5 styles.
material-icons.highlight: Outlined, Filled, Rounded, Sharp and Two-tone — all variable through a font variable.

radix-icons.description: A 15x15 icon set from the Radix team, designed for UI density and clarity.
radix-icons.highlight: A single size optimised for buttons and inputs, with packages for React and Web Components.

iconsax.description: Icon library with over 1,200 free icons across six styles, from Linear to Two Tone.
iconsax.highlight: The official package is a native web component: it works in React, Vue, Svelte or plain HTML, with free and Pro icon sets.

number-flow.description: An animated number component: the digits transition to the new value whenever it changes.
number-flow.highlight: No dependencies, accessible and styleable through CSS parts — works in React, Vue, Svelte and plain JS.

chartjs.description: Canvas charting library with eight built-in chart types, smooth animations and simple configuration.
chartjs.highlight: Lightweight and dependency-free, it renders responsive charts through a declarative dataset API.

echarts.description: Data visualization library with interactive charts, maps and canvas or SVG rendering.
echarts.highlight: Ships dozens of chart types and advanced features such as zoom, brushing and animations in a modular package.

datatables.description: jQuery plugin for tables with search, sorting, pagination and Ajax data loading.
datatables.highlight: One of the web's oldest table setups, with hundreds of extensions and integration with any backend.

handsontable.description: Spreadsheet-like data grid with cell editing, formulas and support for React, Vue and Angular.
handsontable.highlight: Built for enterprise applications: validation, frozen columns and millions of cells with virtualization.

tiptap.description: Headless rich text editor framework with extensions for formatting, collaboration and mentions.
tiptap.highlight: Provides the editor behavior without imposing a look; the interface is built with your stack's components.

lexical.description: Meta's extensible text editor framework, focused on accessibility and performance.
lexical.highlight: Uses its own state model and efficient reconciliation, with support for collaboration and plugins.

slate.description: Framework for building rich text editors with a fully customizable document model.
slate.highlight: It imposes neither schema nor UI: you define the elements, transformations and rendering.

zod.description: Schema validation library with TypeScript type inference, built code-first.
zod.highlight: Schemas are the source of truth: TypeScript infers the static type and runtime validation comes from the same object.

yup.description: Joi-inspired schema validator with a declarative chain and easy-to-customize error messages.
yup.highlight: Popular in React forms for integrating with libraries such as Formik and React Hook Form.

valibot.description: Modular schema validation library with a functional API and a tiny bundle.
valibot.highlight: Each validation is an independent function, so tree-shaking leaves only what the project uses.

date-fns.description: Immutable, modular date library with functions to format, compare and manipulate dates.
date-fns.highlight: Each function is imported separately, keeping the bundle lean and avoiding global dependencies.

dayjs.description: Minimalist Moment.js alternative with an immutable API, optional plugins and just 2 kB.
dayjs.highlight: Keeps Moment's familiar API, but with a plugin tree and a much smaller footprint.

fullcalendar.description: Event calendar with month, week and day views, drag and drop and Google Calendar integration.
fullcalendar.highlight: Has official connectors for React, Vue and Angular, plus a vanilla JavaScript core.

nativewind.description: Tailwind CSS for React Native: use utility classes to style iOS and Android apps with the same syntax as the web.
nativewind.highlight: Brings Tailwind's utility-first workflow to React Native, with dark mode and support for Expo and React Native Web.

gluestack-ui.description: Copy-paste React and React Native components styled with Tailwind CSS for web and mobile.
gluestack-ui.highlight: A copy-paste model with accessible components for React, React Native and Expo, powered by NativeWind.

ui-kitten.description: React Native component library built on the Eva Design System, with 30+ components and light and dark themes.
ui-kitten.highlight: Eva and Material themes with runtime switching, RTL support and on-demand style compilation.

react-native-elements.description: Cross-platform React Native UI toolkit with ready-made components, themes and built-in icons.
react-native-elements.highlight: One of the ecosystem's most established kits, with a themed package and components for iOS, Android and web.

react-native-reusables.description: Copy-paste React Native components styled with Tailwind CSS, in the style of shadcn/ui and ready for Expo.
react-native-reusables.highlight: Brings the shadcn/ui model to mobile: open code, no component package, with support for NativeWind and Uniwind.
